decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication system sits close to the firm's core machine-tool fluid business. Industry turnover is growing and the firm is expanding and investing, so it has the slack to carry the product. There is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's modular filtration platform and fits its one-stop offer. Growing demand and available slack make it likely that results meet aspirations, so management has no reason to drop it.

The gravity band filter is a standard, low-risk addition to the firm's established coolant filtration range. It shares manufacturing and service resources with existing products and would be retained in an expanding firm.
